name: Dribble

primary.name: Bounce
primary.description: Bounce forward for a narrow close hit: 29 damage, 88 reach, 40-degree arc.

secondary.name: Triple Bounce
secondary.description: Bounce your whole body quickly between up to three different enemies: 28 damage each. First target within 350 units; later jumps within 260. Walls stop travel. You can still take damage.

passive: Rebound: heal for 8% of damage dealt.

technique.name: Wide Court
technique.description: Bounce between targets 50% farther apart, for 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: Backboard Break
final_technique.description: Two bouncing-looking arcs return to Dribble, hitting for 25 per leg. Trades the minion for an aimed returning attack.

attack.name: Backboard Break
attack.description: Two bouncing-looking arcs return to Dribble, hitting for 25 per leg. Trades the minion for an aimed returning attack.
